texts.name: Murdoch
texts.biography: Murdoch is one to call a professional soldier of fortune. He likes few things more than money and fame. Those urges are what led Murdoch to gather a company of fellow daredevils and head out to seek adventures in Jadamean wilderness. Who knows where fate will take him next.

specialty.name: Archery
specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
